event.summary: Retired bundle helpers leave no retained page dependency
event.detail: Reviewed commit: f560058da19e02716e6f943883a9508b447aff4e. TLDR: considered whether deleting the assigned xterm event, collection, scheduling and cancellation helpers breaks terminal mounts or leaves their cleanup dependent on missing code. Suggested bucket: high if the dependency existed, because terminal mounts could fail; no established loss-of-work or security consequence. Could-be-highest: false. Confidence: confirmed source refutation, not behavior observed in execution. proposed_drop: the helpers are private to a fully deleted bundle, and the page's remaining terminal mounts and teardown use the independent grid implementation. possible_cover: none. Details: assigned packets 01085-024, 01085-025 and 01085-026 are consecutive regions of the same deleted bundle line, including TimeoutTimer split across the first two packets and CancellationTokenSource split across the last two; the deletion is atomic rather than a surviving half-definition. git diff --summary confirms delete mode for the entire asset. The parent bundle's final 6500 bytes show the private webpack loader resolving module exports internally and returning a public export object populated with Terminal only; no assigned helper is separately installed on the page. The original consumers found in the parent revision are terminal.js:3588 (window.Terminal readiness), :3900 (constructor), lib.rs:1387-1389 and :2060-2062 (asset declarations and load), and terminal-files.test.js:418-419 (direct require and constructor). Source at the reviewed revision removes the xterm readiness and constructor, mounts farhelmGridTerminal at terminal.js:4313, loads the grid assets at lib.rs:1921-1925, and deletes the test that directly required the retired bundle in the same commit. Searches at the reviewed revision over crates/farhelm-ui for those asset/global/helper names returned no matches; a further search over crates, scripts and .github for vendor/xterm, window.Terminal, VENDOR_XTERM, TimeoutTimer, CancellationTokenSource and ThrottledWorker also returned none. Earlier source checks establish independent cleanup at terminal.js:4760-4829 and grid-terminal.js:2109-2140, including document gesture listener removal at :1754-1758. Governing contract: SPEC_impl.md:1504-1514 makes every terminal a supervisor-interpreted grid stream and :1835-1845 assigns mounts to terminal.js and the grid assets. Synthesis resolves the previously implicit assumption that these helpers were bundle-private and that direct non-page consumers were retired together. All conclusions are source-based; no runtime tests or reproductions were performed. Caveat: this refutes the missing-helper dependency concern only; the neighboring groups own replacement behavior beyond this group's deletion boundary.
